troubleshooting.title: The recording is silent
troubleshooting.shortdesc: You pressed Record but the waveform is a flat line and playback is silent: the input device, its level or its permissions are wrong.

condition.title: Condition
condition.p: You click Record, the track appears, but the waveform stays a flat line. Playing the track produces no sound.

cause.title: The wrong input device is selected
cause.p: The Device Toolbar is set to a device that is not connected, or to a line input rather than the microphone.

step.cmd: In the Device Toolbar, open the recording device list and choose your microphone.
Choose TransportRescan Audio Devices if the microphone is missing from the list.

cause.title: The input level is zero
cause.p: The recording volume slider is at its minimum, so the device is selected but nothing is captured.

step.cmd: Drag the recording volume slider (the one with the microphone icon) to about three quarters.
Click the recording meter to start monitoring, then speak; the meter should move.

cause.title: macOS has not granted microphone access
cause.p: The first time an application asks to use the microphone, macOS asks for permission. If the request was refused, records silence.

steps-informal.p: Open System SettingsPrivacy and SecurityMicrophone, switch on , then restart it.
